ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Load audit
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
A Pickle step that checks the game log for one mod: an error, an exception or a warning that comes from it, a definition or reference the game says does not resolve, the same message repeated, and its translations missing from the active language. Optional developer tooling: no Defs, no features, nothing runs unless a scenario asks for it. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See LoadAudit/README.md at the repository root.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; no gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps. Runtime coverage and limitations are documented in the repository.
